t: Church & Dwight Co Inc Company Profile - Church & Dwight Co Inc Overview - GlobalData
s: Church & Dwight Co Inc (Church & Dwight) manufactures and distributes personal care, household, and specialty products. Its primary product categories include deodorizers, household cleaning products, oral care products, laundry detergents, vitamin and mineral supplements, and home pregnancy and ovulation test kits. It also offers specialty chemicals and specialty cleaners. The company markets its products under the brands Arm & Hammer, OxiClean, Xtra, Clean Shower, Spinbrush, Nair, Trojan, First Response, Orajel, Vitafusion, L’il Critters, Batiste, Waterpik, Celmanax, and Certillus.
